title: Washington Seller Disclosure Statement (Form 17)
description: Washington RCW 64.06 requires sellers of improved residential property (1-4 units) to complete a Seller Disclosure Statement. Must be delivered within 5 business days of mutual acceptance. Buyer has 3 business days to rescind.

required_actions.note: Buyer has 3 business days to rescind after receiving Form 17.

title: Environmental / Underground Tank Disclosure
description: Washington Form 17 requires disclosure of underground storage tanks, contamination, hazardous waste, and proximity to Superfund sites.

required_actions.note: Disclosed on WA-SDS-FORM-17 Section III Environmental. Provide any Dept. of Ecology correspondence.

title: Lead Paint Renovation Advisement
description: Washington adopts EPA RRP Rule; contractors in pre-1978 homes must be EPA-certified. Sellers should advise buyers who plan to renovate.

required_actions.note: Inform buyer of EPA RRP requirements if they plan to renovate.
